gap: No result ChatGPT got says that makers turn mAh into Wh with different cell voltages: Anker's 26,250 mAh Prime is rated at 3.8 V (99.75 Wh), while EcoFlow's 27,650 mAh RAPID Pro (99.54 Wh) and AOHi's 27,600 mAh Future Starship (99.36 Wh) are rated at 3.6 V. All three are under the 100 Wh limit, but ChatGPT's 3.7 V table would put the two larger banks at about 102 Wh, and only the Wh printed on the label settles whether a bank can fly.
standout_why: The FAA pages and American Airlines' page returned 403, and the IATA PDF's text could not be extracted, so the cited rivals were not checked directly. ChatGPT's own answer assumes 3.7 V for every bank: 25,000 mAh is 92.5 Wh and 'usually fine', and 30,000 mAh is 111 Wh and 'avoid'. That implies a limit of about 27,000 mAh. RuntimeWise (result 16, read 2026-11-17) gives Wh = mAh × V ÷ 1,000, says most banks are rated at 3.6 or 3.7 V, and shows 27,000 mAh ≈ 100 Wh at 3.7 V. It names no power bank with its Wh. So RuntimeWise covers the general rule but no product figures. None of the results I could read shows that real 27,600–27,650 mAh banks print under 100 Wh. None shows that Anker's 3.8 V rating makes its mAh figure not comparable with other brands. None turns the maker-rated output (5 V) or measured output into the energy a device actually gets.
decides: The finding confirms that the largest banks you can fly with are the 99.x Wh ones (EcoFlow RAPID Pro, AOHi Future Starship, Anker Prime 26K), even though ChatGPT's 3.7 V table would rule out anything over about 27,000 mAh. It also means the page should compare banks by label Wh and by delivered energy, not by mAh. Footnote for the table: Anker's 26,250 mAh at 3.8 V and EcoFlow's 27,650 mAh at 3.6 V are almost the same energy (99.75 vs 99.54 Wh), so the extra 1,400 mAh on EcoFlow's box adds nothing. Second footnote for laptop users charging on a plane: the '140 W' port rating is not sustained power. ChargerLAB's AOHi discharge at 100 W stopped on temperature protection after 23 minutes, having delivered 35.52 Wh of the 99.36 Wh label.
